name: Excel Splitter
description: Split Excel workbooks by sheet, column value, or complex rules
author: FengYu

aiTools.name: excel_analyze
aiTools.description: Analyze an Excel file and return sheets and headers.

aiTools.name: excel_configure
aiTools.description: Configure BY_SHEET, BY_COLUMN, or COMPLEX splitting.

aiTools.name: excel_complex_config
aiTools.description: Add, list, or clear complex split rules.

aiTools.name: excel_execute
aiTools.description: Execute the configured split into an authorized output directory.

aiTools.name: excel_query
aiTools.description: Query the active Excel split session.

aiTools.name: excel_cancel
aiTools.description: Cancel and clear the active Excel split session.
